name: orcel
description: Local-first MCP gateway with 41 bounded tools and local approval for computer changes.
long_description: Orcel exposes 41 bounded tools for trusted workspace files, local Git, registered argv-only processes, structured desktop observation and Full User desktop control, clipboard access, approved public HTTPS fetches, and optional web search through a provider the user enables through a local policy kernel. Full User desktop authority is granted only through a local STRONG-presence flow and is never grantable by MCP or remote callers. This extension launches the installed Orcel entrypoint over stdio; no tunnel is required.

tools.name: clipboard_read
tools.description: Read the clipboard text once after local approval; secrets are refused.

tools.name: clipboard_write
tools.description: Place text on the clipboard once after local approval; never pastes.

tools.name: desktop_cursor_get
tools.description: Read cursor position under active local Full User desktop authority.

tools.name: desktop_element_invoke
tools.description: Invoke one eligible UI Automation element after Full User lease and approval checks.

tools.name: desktop_element_scroll
tools.description: Scroll one eligible UI Automation element after Full User lease and approval checks.

tools.name: desktop_element_select
tools.description: Select one eligible UI Automation element after Full User lease and approval checks.

tools.name: desktop_element_set_value
tools.description: Set one eligible non-password UI Automation value after Full User lease and approval checks.

tools.name: desktop_element_toggle
tools.description: Toggle one eligible UI Automation element after Full User lease and approval checks.

tools.name: desktop_input_execute
tools.description: Execute one bounded real mouse or keyboard action after Full User lease and approval checks.

tools.name: desktop_window_action
tools.description: Focus, minimize, maximize, restore, or close one exact typed window after Full User lease and approval checks.

tools.name: desktop_window_capture
tools.description: Capture one exact typed window after Full User lease and approval checks.

tools.name: desktop_window_list
tools.description: List visible top-level windows of other applications in the current interactive Windows session, read-only.

tools.name: desktop_window_tree
tools.description: Read the bounded UI Automation control tree of one listed window, read-only, with password values never read.

tools.name: fs_edit
tools.description: Replace exact text in one file bound to its SHA-256 after local approval.

tools.name: fs_find
tools.description: Find files by a bounded name glob in a trusted workspace without following links.

tools.name: fs_list
tools.description: List one directory inside a trusted workspace without following symlinks.

tools.name: fs_mkdir
tools.description: Create a directory in a trusted workspace after local approval.

tools.name: fs_move
tools.description: Move or rename one entry within a trusted workspace after local approval, never overwriting.

tools.name: fs_read
tools.description: Read one bounded UTF-8 text file inside a trusted workspace.

tools.name: fs_read_range
tools.description: Read a bounded line range of one UTF-8 text file in a trusted workspace.

tools.name: fs_remove
tools.description: Remove one file or empty directory after Windows Hello; no recursive delete.

tools.name: fs_search
tools.description: Search bounded UTF-8 text files inside a trusted workspace.

tools.name: fs_stat
tools.description: Read metadata for a relative path inside a trusted workspace.

tools.name: fs_write
tools.description: Write exact UTF-8 content inside a trusted workspace after local approval.

tools.name: fs_write_preview
tools.description: Preview an exact UTF-8 file write without mutating the computer.

tools.name: git_branch_create
tools.description: Create and switch to one new local Git branch after approval.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Create one local Git commit after approval.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Read a bounded Git diff.

tools.name: git_fetch
tools.description: Fetch one validated branch after approval.

tools.name: git_fetch_preview
tools.description: Preview one bounded Git HTTPS fetch without mutation.

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Read bounded Git commit history.

tools.name: git_push
tools.description: Push one validated branch after approval.

tools.name: git_push_preview
tools.description: Preview one bounded Git HTTPS push without mutation.

tools.name: git_stage
tools.description: Stage listed files after approval.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Read Git working-tree and branch status.

tools.name: git_unstage
tools.description: Unstage listed files after approval.

tools.name: process_spawn
tools.description: Execute one argv-only process after fresh local approval.

tools.name: system_status
tools.description: Read Orcel daemon status.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch one public HTTPS URL with GET after local approval of the destination.

tools.name: report_commit
tools.description: Create the previewed report, create-only, after local approval of exactly that file; Orcel then verifies it independently.

tools.name: report_preview
tools.description: Check a proposed report against its task without writing anything.

tools.name: report_start
tools.description: Start a local report task over 1 to 8 workspace text files; reads only.

tools.name: task_resume_summary
tools.description: After a reconnect, read what this session's report task did and what is unknown; reads only.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web through a provider the user enabled locally, after local approval of the query.

tools.name: workspace_get
tools.description: Read the configured trusted workspace metadata.
